set.body: From S5.4 review. Protocol 1.3 removes AdmissionSummary.inventoryTrials/absent; the transport compares majors only (Transport.scala ~236, ~290), so a 1.2 peer fails decode as Malformed rather than UnsupportedVersion. Either bump the major on breaking changes or have the client check minors and answer UnsupportedVersion. Must be settled before any out-of-process backend (S3.7).
set.title: Studio protocol: typed refusal for breaking minor versions
